## Classes

### <a name="incron"></a>`incron`

Main entry point for incron class which must be included
in order to start managing all incron-related resources.

#### Examples

##### Installing incron

```puppet
include incron
```

##### Uninstalling incron and all related resources

```puppet
class { 'incron':
  ensure => absent,
}
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `incron` class:

* [`ensure`](#-incron--ensure)
* [`package_version`](#-incron--package_version)
* [`allowed_users`](#-incron--allowed_users)
* [`denied_users`](#-incron--denied_users)
* [`root_group`](#-incron--root_group)
* [`conf_file`](#-incron--conf_file)
* [`allow_file`](#-incron--allow_file)
* [`deny_file`](#-incron--deny_file)
* [`incrond_dir`](#-incron--incrond_dir)
* [`spool_dir`](#-incron--spool_dir)
* [`service_name`](#-incron--service_name)
* [`service_manage`](#-incron--service_manage)
* [`service_ensure`](#-incron--service_ensure)
* [`service_enable`](#-incron--service_enable)
* [`purge_noop`](#-incron--purge_noop)

##### <a name="-incron--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Enum[present, absent]`

Whether to enable or disable incron on the system.

Default value: `present`

##### <a name="-incron--package_version"></a>`package_version`

Data type: `String[1]`

Provide custom `incron` package version here.

Default value: `installed`

##### <a name="-incron--allowed_users"></a>`allowed_users`

Data type: `Array[String[1]]`

List of users allowed to use `incrontab(1)`. `root` will be added automatically.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-incron--denied_users"></a>`denied_users`

Data type: `Array[String[1]]`

List of users specifically denied to use `incrontab(1)`.
Note: When this is not empty, all users except ones specified here will be able to use `incrontab`.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-incron--root_group"></a>`root_group`

Data type: `String[1]`

Name of the root group (`wheel` on FreeBSD).

Default value: `'root'`

##### <a name="-incron--conf_file"></a>`conf_file`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Path to the `incron.conf` file.

Default value: `'/etc/incron.conf'`

##### <a name="-incron--allow_file"></a>`allow_file`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Path to the `incron.allow` file.

Default value: `'/etc/incron.allow'`

##### <a name="-incron--deny_file"></a>`deny_file`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Path to the `incron.deny` file.

Default value: `'/etc/incron.deny'`

##### <a name="-incron--incrond_dir"></a>`incrond_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Path to the system incron tables directory (`incron.d`).

Default value: `'/etc/incron.d'`

##### <a name="-incron--spool_dir"></a>`spool_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Path to the per-user incron tables spool directory.

Default value: `'/var/spool/incron'`

##### <a name="-incron--service_name"></a>`service_name`

Data type: `String[1]`

Incron service's name.

Default value: `'incrond'`

##### <a name="-incron--service_manage"></a>`service_manage`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to manage incron service at all.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-incron--service_ensure"></a>`service_ensure`

Data type: `Enum[running, stopped]`

Incron service's 'ensure' parameter.

Default value: `running`

##### <a name="-incron--service_enable"></a>`service_enable`

Data type: `Boolean`

Incron service's 'enable' parameter.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-incron--purge_noop"></a>`purge_noop`

Data type: `Boolean`

Run purging in `noop` mode.

Default value: `false`

## Defined types

### <a name="incron--job"></a>`incron::job`

Primary incron resource used to create incron jobs.

#### Examples

##### Using incron::job resource

```puppet
incron::job { 'process_file':
  path    => '/upload',
  event   => 'IN_CLOSE_WRITE',
  command => '/usr/bin/process_file $#',
}
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `incron::job` defined type:

* [`command`](#-incron--job--command)
* [`event`](#-incron--job--event)
* [`path`](#-incron--job--path)
* [`user`](#-incron--job--user)

##### <a name="-incron--job--command"></a>`command`

Data type: `String[1]`

Command to execute on triggered event.

##### <a name="-incron--job--event"></a>`event`

Data type: `Variant[Incron::Event, Array[Incron::Event, 2]]`

inotify event (or an array of events).

##### <a name="-incron--job--path"></a>`path`

Data type: `Stdlib::Unixpath`

Path to watched directory.

##### <a name="-incron--job--user"></a>`user`

Data type: `String[1]`

User that owns incron job.

Default value: `'root'`

### <a name="incron--whitelist"></a>`incron::whitelist`

Use this to whitelist any system incron jobs you don't want to touch.
This will make sure that `${incron::incrond_dir}/${title}` won't get deleted
nor modified.

#### Examples

##### Using incron::whitelist resource

```puppet
incron::whitelist { 'uploader': }
```

## Data types

inotify event type
